questions.unnecessary_complexity: No. R3 reuses the established R2 transaction shape: exact pins, append-only control records and one tree-preserving two-parent ancestry commit.
questions.duplicate_truth: No. main remains the owner of registry and PC0 policy; ECO remains the owner of its research branch facts. No registry or passport content is copied into a new truth surface.
questions.implicit_owner: No. The candidate changes ancestry only and introduces no new architecture owner, authority layer, runtime manager or persistence boundary.
questions.coupling_reduction: Yes. Exact main becomes an ancestor, removing the main-to-ECO critical dependency-drift condition instead of masking it with copied control content.
questions.sibling_surface_fix: Checked exact source tree, source passport blob, both parents, merge-base, first-parent tree equality, R2 terminal invalidation, current active program watched paths, standard PC0 semantics and directional PC0 semantics.
questions.removable_code: No runtime or research code was added by the integration candidate. R3 execution records are durable recovery evidence.
questions.design_regression: No. Candidate 64592d41 exactly follows the reviewed HIGH design and preserves the current ECO content tree.
questions.refactor_if_redesigned: No refactor is warranted. A future harness improvement should let canonical PC0 accept an explicit synthetic branch-ref override so this check does not require mutating a disposable local remote-tracking ref.
